column1: # Real read-novel.com pages, unedited. The host answers a plain request, so
# these were fetched directly; the crawl was paced anyway, since two other
# sites on this list start serving an interstitial after a few quick requests.
# capture_url and app_url are the same: one host, no second spelling.
# columns: site  file  capture_url  app_url  kind  completed  chapters  max_page
# `chapters` is the DISTINCT chapter links inside #list-chapter — NOT
# #new-chapter, which is a six-link "latest chapters" widget using the same
# ul.list-chapter class — and `max_page` the highest "?p=N" in the pagination.
# Both measured at capture time with bs4/lxml, never with this app's parser,
# so the tests cross-check the two readings.
# The 100 are 23 finished and 77 ongoing (every finished novel the site's own
# completed catalogue lists), across listings of 1 page to 131.
